races.name: Golf At Gowran Park Optional Claiming Race

runners_data.name: Independent Expert
runners_data.note: Front-running style perfectly suited to claiming grade, 28 days since last run freshens him up nicely
runners_data.comment: Naas winner over this trip in March; favourite's chance on ratings
runners_data.spotlight: Eight-time winner, most recently Naas handicap over this trip in March (soft); safely held both starts since but closely matched with Gloriously Glam on C&D run on these better terms.

runners_data.name: West Sedona
runners_data.note: Complete unknown making debut with 7lb claiming rider, Arizona breeding suggests stamina for 7f
runners_data.comment: Arizona gelding cost 6,000euros as yearling; newcomer likely best watched
runners_data.spotlight: Arizona gelding cost 6,000euros as yearling and later resold for 5,000euros; second foal; dam won in Spain, half-sister to winners Unexpected Party (smart 2m-2m6f hurdle/chase) and Dolphin Village (prolific 1m2f-1m5f); newcomer likely best watched.

runners_data.name: Venetian
runners_data.note: Prominent racer drops significantly in grade after busy AW campaign, Hogan stable in decent form
runners_data.comment: Bit to find here at the weights although rider's claim brings him into the mix
runners_data.spotlight: Kept very busy on AW in recent months, notably collared close home over 7f off 77; didn't count back on turf at Bellewstown last month and looks to have a bit to find here at the weights although rider's claim brings him into the mix.

runners_data.name: Clonmacash
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse needs strong pace, recent 6f Dundalk win suggests return to form for McGuinness yard
runners_data.comment: This trip his maximum on the AW so won't want too much rain here
runners_data.spotlight: Fully exposed 5yo but recorded the best RPR of his 51-race career when winning at Dundalk last month (6f); tame enough Chester run since and drops to claiming company here; won't want too much rain.

runners_data.name: Gloriously Glam
runners_data.note: Stays better than stablemate Clonmacash, prominent style suits and has winning C&D form in claimers
runners_data.comment: Goes well here, claiming winner last year; trip/ground to suit, definite contender
runners_data.spotlight: Second runner for the yard and stays better than Clonmacash, two wins last year coming at 1m, including claimer here; best of three runs this term came over C&D last month when fourth in decent fillies handicap; trip/ground to suit, definite contender.

runners_data.name: Salacious
runners_data.note: Hold-up maiden faces stiff task from poor draw, 59 days off track may need this run
runners_data.comment: Stiff task latest; down in grade and could go well; yard had winner at Navan on Saturday
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden went closest when beaten a nose in Dundalk handicap over this trip in February; good run at the Curragh subsequently (heavy) but stiff task from out of handicap at Naas last time; could go well, yard had a winner at Navan on Saturday.

runners_data.name: Profit Surge
runners_data.note: Hold-up maiden with Colin Keane booking suggests each-way chances, recent AW form solid
runners_data.comment: Low-grade maiden seemingly has plenty on at the weights
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden was placed three times in AW handicaps in December/January, most recently respectable third in low-grade Roscommon handicap; plenty on at the weights here.

runners_data.name: Fly To Glory
runners_data.note: Prominent 7-year-old switching yards, poor debut for new connections raises questions
runners_data.comment: Five-time winner on AW ; poor yard debut effort at Dundalk in February; unlikely one
runners_data.spotlight: Five-time winner on AW at 6f/7f for Pat Murphy; poor yard debut effort at Dundalk in February when ridden by 10lb claimer; seems an unlikely one here.

runners_data.name: Green Kite
runners_data.note: Hold-up maiden who fades in finish, testing ground may help stamina but draw unhelpful
runners_data.comment: Didn't feature on Limerick comeback run and looks to have a bit to do on ratings
runners_data.spotlight: Lightly raced maiden's best run came when runner-up in 1m Killarney maiden on testing ground last October; didn't feature on Limerick comeback run last month and looks to have a bit to do on ratings.

runners_data.name: Royal Sapphire
runners_data.note: Hold-up style, fades badly in finishes, last start was dismal and hard to recommend
runners_data.comment: Nothing so far, badly away in Ballinrobe claimer latest
runners_data.spotlight: AW form over the winter didn't amount to much and last of 10 (never recovering from slow start) in Ballinrobe claimer earlier this month on turf debut; hard to make a case for.

races.paceDynamic: Independent Expert will likely take this field along at a steady tempo from the front, with Venetian, Gloriously Glam and Fly To Glory tracking closely in the prominent positions. The pace should be honest but sustainable over 7f, creating no undue pressure on the early leaders. With multiple hold-up horses including Clonmacash, Salacious and Green Kite needing to be delivered late, the combination of soft ground and moderate early gallop will make it difficult for backmarkers to close effectively. This race shape clearly favours prominent racers and front-runners who can dictate terms and have fewer horses to pass.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runners Control
scenarios.trigger: If Independent Expert gets an uncontested lead and the pace stays moderate
scenarios.body: The leader gets first run and maintains momentum while hold-up horses struggle to make ground on the testing surface. Prominent racers like Venetian and Gloriously Glam are perfectly positioned to challenge if the leader weakens.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Power Play
scenarios.trigger: If Venetian or Gloriously Glam apply early pressure and force a stronger gallop
scenarios.body: The increased tempo sets up perfectly for horses tracking in second or third, allowing them to kick clear as both leaders and hold-up horses struggle. McGuinness's stable form gives Gloriously Glam the edge in a tactical battle.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Success
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a crawl through halfway
scenarios.body: Hold-up horses get the slow-run race they need, with Clonmacash's recent Dundalk win and Colin Keane's booking of Profit Surge suggesting connections expect a tactical affair. The finishing kick becomes crucial on the testing ground.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Newcomer Shock
scenarios.trigger: If West Sedona shows immediate ability on debut and the pace suits a closer
scenarios.body: The Arizona-bred gelding capitalizes on a moderate gallop from midfield, with Jimmy Dalton's 7lb claim helping significantly. Lightly-raced horses often thrive in claiming company when stepping down in grade.

watchPoints.text: Independent Expert may get too soft a lead if no pace pressure develops early from the prominent horses
West Sedona's market moves on debut - any strong support would be significant for unknown Arizona gelding
Gloriously Glam versus stablemate Clonmacash tactics from McGuinness yard with both horses having winning chances
Colin Keane's choice of Profit Surge over other available rides suggests connections fancy their chances
Going changes from Good To Soft in headline to Good To Yielding in reports - watch for any further updates

races.paceDynamic: Rampage stands alone as the confirmed front runner in this large field, giving him complete tactical control from the outset. With prominent runners Not Simple, Bright Image, and Master Garvey likely sitting just behind him, the pace should be reasonable rather than punishing. The majority of the field are hold-up horses who will need the race to develop, creating a wall of traffic in behind. This tactical setup strongly favours hold-up horses with strong finishing kicks, as they can benefit from the solid pace and pick off tired leaders.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Rampage sets a decent gallop and the prominent horses don't pressure him too early...
scenarios.body: The pace will be honest enough to set up the race for closers, with plenty of cover available for the back markers. Strong finishers like Staywitherjohnny and Mythical Rock can time their runs perfectly in the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace collapses late
scenarios.trigger: If Rampage goes too slow early and the prominent horses fail to inject pace...
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the two-furlong pole, suiting horses with natural speed over stamina. Prominent runners who haven't used up their energy reserves will have the advantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Rampage wire-to-wire
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses behind Rampage fail to mount any sustained challenge...
scenarios.body: The pace will be too modest to trouble the leader, allowing him to kick clear turning for home. His tactical advantage becomes decisive in a slowly-run race.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic nightmare chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the large field bunches up turning for home with multiple horses looking for racing room...
scenarios.body: Several hold-up horses will find their runs blocked at crucial moments, allowing those with clear runs to capitalize. Luck in running becomes the decisive factor.

watchPoints.text: Rampage could get an uncontested lead with 18 runners potentially allowing him to dictate throughout
Traffic problems inevitable turning for home with so many hold-up horses in a large field
Staywitherjohnny's champion jockey booking Dylan Browne McMonagle suggests strong stable confidence
Multiple horses returning from lengthy layoffs including Bright Image, Just Another Eagle, and Oreeda
Several apprentice jockeys riding which could impact tactical positioning in such a large competitive field

races.paceDynamic: Sparan Nua will take the field along from the front without serious pressure in this small field, with Lady Mairen likely to settle prominently but not challenging the leader early. The two hold-up horses, Vauntingly and Marmeladova, will be giving the front-runners a significant start over this 1m1½f trip. With only one confirmed pace-setter, Sparan Nua can dictate fractions and control the race from pillar to post. This race shape strongly favours front-running and prominent tactics, as the hold-up horses face a difficult task conceding early ground in such a small field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Sparan Nua maintains her Naas form and controls the pace uncontested.
scenarios.body: The 25-1 Naas winner can kick clear in the straight with tactical advantage and improving momentum. Hold-up horses Vauntingly and Marmeladova struggle to make up the ground from their patient positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Challenger Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Lady Mairen shows her best form and challenges Sparan Nua approaching the straight.
scenarios.body: The experienced mare can use her class advantage and prominent position to wear down the front-runner late. Her Group 3 experience at two gives her the quality edge in this company.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Revival
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes unsustainably fast between Sparan Nua and Lady Mairen early.
scenarios.body: Marmeladova can benefit from her recent Navan win and strong finish to pick up the pieces late. The 5-year-old mare showed much-improved form last time out after disappointing efforts.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Newcomer Breakthrough
scenarios.trigger: If Vauntingly overcomes her slow-breaking tendency and gets a clean passage.
scenarios.body: The once-raced filly can build on her promising debut third and benefit if the pace collapses. However, her hold-up style faces a tough ask against the likely uncontested leader.

watchPoints.text: Sparan Nua breaking cleanly and establishing early lead without pressure - if uncontested she becomes very difficult to peg back
Lady Mairen's early positioning - if she tracks the leader closely rather than letting her go, it changes the pace dynamic significantly
Vauntingly's start - her debut slow break cost her dearly and she cannot afford similar in this small field
Marmeladova finding early cover - with limited pace on she needs to be closer than usual to her hold-up style
The pace through halfway - if it becomes crawling both hold-up horses become more dangerous late

races.name: Family Fun Day June 1st Handicap

runners_data.name: Whats New
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid recent hurdles form, 51 days off but trainer/jockey combination and tactical position favours
runners_data.comment: Has made the frame in two runs over hurdles since a below-par Flat run at Navan
runners_data.spotlight: Has made the frame in two runs in maiden hurdles (soundly beaten both times) since a below-par Flat run at Navan; last season's Roscommon win was gained over 1m4f; later ran well over 1m6f at the Curragh, so no major stamina doubt.

runners_data.name: Makaiah
runners_data.note: Sharp recent second at Roscommon, prominent style ideal for this pace setup, only 9 days between runs
runners_data.comment: First reserve, started last season brightly, same this term when runner-up at Roscommon
runners_data.spotlight: Started last season brightly with three placed efforts before a 1m5f Navan win; began this term on a positive note when runner-up at Roscommon nine days ago; would merit consideration if getting a run; first reserve.

runners_data.name: Quiz Test
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse faces traffic problems with Shane Foley, decent autumn form but tactical disadvantage here
runners_data.comment: Almost three years since his only win, fair form last autumn, may improve from a Cork run
runners_data.spotlight: Sole win came at Cork in 2023; decent form last autumn, including a close third over 1m4f at Galway and second in a 19-runner contest at the Curragh, with Whats New, Earthsong and Bruant behind; may improve from a Cork run, but has to reverse form with Celtic Drud and Earthsong.

runners_data.name: Paradise Lost
runners_data.note: Long absence of 212 days major concern, hold-up style unsuited to likely pace scenario
runners_data.comment: Placed over hurdles on his two most recent starts, two undistinguished Flat runs last year
runners_data.spotlight: Placed over hurdles on his two most recent outings; two undistinguished Flat runs last season; better judged on the form he showed near the end of the 2024 campaign, although seems best suited by soft ground.

runners_data.name: Earthsong
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner faces crowded finish, 25 days since last run should have him fit enough
runners_data.comment: Has shown winning potential in staying handicaps, might not cope with Celtic Druid here
runners_data.spotlight: Best effort came on handicap debut over 1m6f at Navan on yielding ground last August; produced another solid display at that venue last month, prominent all the way before losing fourth place to Celtic Druid; that rival finished well after getting into the clear and may uphold the form.

runners_data.name: Eben Zaabeel
runners_data.note: Third reserve unlikely to run, hold-up style would face traffic issues anyway
runners_data.spotlight: Seven-race maiden in Britain for Charlie Hills, runner-up in AW handicaps final two starts in 2024; yet to match that form in Ireland; third reserve.

runners_data.name: Miss Gitana
runners_data.note: Hold-up style in large field problematic, inconsistent hurdles form this season
runners_data.comment: Down the field on stable debut in the Navan race in which Celtic Druid was fourth
runners_data.spotlight: Three Flat wins, twice in Britain and over 2m at Tramore last April for Gordon Elliott; disappointing over hurdles on last two starts in 2025; down the field on stable debut in the Navan race in which Celtic Druid was fourth.

runners_data.name: Eternal Echo
runners_data.note: Handicap debutant from strong stable, hold-up style faces tactical challenge but unexposed
runners_data.comment: Bumper/maiden hurdle winner for Gordon Elliott, could be a dark horse on handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Bumper/maiden hurdle winner for Gordon Elliott; has been running over shorter trips in maidens and could be a dark horse on handicap debut; not disgraced at this venue on the first of his two Flat starts for this stable.

runners_data.name: Eastern Blue Bird
runners_data.note: 194 days absence too long, modest form suggests limited chance regardless of tactics
runners_data.comment: Modest form in bumpers and over hurdles, in rear at Dundalk on his Flat handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Modest form in bumpers and over hurdles; 50-1 when in rear at Dundalk on his Flat handicap debut; hard to fancy.

runners_data.name: Mr Rango
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse ran just 2 days ago at Roscommon, quick turnaround and traffic concerns
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time winner at 1m2f on soft or heavy, latest over two years ago; fair form this season but needs to find extra; ran in the 7.50 at Roscommon on Monday.

runners_data.name: Parish Express
runners_data.note: Sole front runner gives her tactical advantage, recent steering issues a slight concern
runners_data.comment: Second reserve, weak form in maidens, in rear in a Roscommon handicap after steering issue
runners_data.spotlight: Weak form in maidens; in rear in a Roscommon handicap last week after steering issue that saw her hang to the left off the bend with a circuit to go; senior rider set to take over now; second reserve.

runners_data.name: Medieval Night
runners_data.note: Steps up in trip after poor short-distance runs, hold-up style needs luck in running
runners_data.comment: Placed over 1m1f for Dermot Weld, steps up in trip after two moderate runs for this stable
runners_data.spotlight: Pick of six runs for Dermot Weld when runner-up in 1m1f Leopardstown handicap (good) last August; steps up in trip after two moderate runs for this stable; plenty to prove.

runners_data.name: Sonic Invader
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner sharp after seasonal reappearance, Colin Keane booking positive but traffic risk
runners_data.comment: Was entitled to need the run at Navan after a year-long absence, should be sharper now
runners_data.spotlight: Ran in three maidens early last season; was entitled to need the run at Navan after a year-long absence; should be sharper now; Colin Keane takes over from an apprentice.

runners_data.name: Bruant
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with fading tendency faces worst possible race shape for his running style
runners_data.comment: Two Flat wins in France, no sign of his best form since a novice hurdle win last summer
runners_data.spotlight: Two Flat wins in France; no sign of his best form since a novice hurdle win at Downpatrick last summer; premature to write off now that he has dropped in the ratings, but appears well held by Celtic Druid on Navan running; first-time with hood

runners_data.name: Master Sydney
runners_data.note: Recent bumper winner stepping up in trip, hold-up style needs clear passage in large field
runners_data.comment: Good-ground bumper winner, recent Roscommon sixth was satisfactory, champion jockey booked
runners_data.spotlight: Won a mares' bumper at Roscommon last July (good); fair effort on Flat handicap debut at Down Royal (1m5f, yielding); 1m2f too sharp on seasonal return; recent Roscommon sixth was satisfactory; champion jockey booked, new headgear combination.

runners_data.name: Celtic Druid
runners_data.note: Progressive AW winner but 7lb claimer faces traffic problems with hold-up style
runners_data.comment: Maintained AW progression with Navan fourth, 7lb claimer is starting to establish herself
runners_data.spotlight: Progressive in winning back-to-back 1m4f handicaps at Dundalk in March/April; had to wait for a gap to open at Navan last time  and ran on well to take fourth, 1 3/4l in front of Earthsong; very capable 7lb claimer is starting to establish herself; strong contender.

runners_data.name: Good Onya Mate
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with fading tendency in large field, 7lb claimer booking suggests limited chance
runners_data.comment: Chance is not obvious, but the stable had a massive-priced double at Naas on Sunday
runners_data.spotlight: Always at the back when 25-1 at Ballinrobe in his first handicap; his chance is not obvious, but the stable had a massive-priced double at Naas on Sunday.

races.paceDynamic: Parish Express is the sole confirmed front runner with Whats New and Makaiah likely to press early from prominent positions. With only three horses wanting to be up with the pace, Parish Express should get an uncontested lead and dictate terms through moderate fractions. The large field of hold-up horses including Quiz Test, Paradise Lost, Earthsong and Master Sydney will be bunched behind waiting to strike. This tactical setup strongly favours the front runners and prominent racers who can avoid traffic problems, while the mass of hold-up horses will struggle to find racing room in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Parish Express gets uncontested fractions and maintains her gallop
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows her to control the race completely, while the crowded field of hold-up horses gets in each other's way down the straight. McDonogh can dictate when to quicken and the trailing pack arrives too late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Takes Over
scenarios.trigger: If Whats New and Makaiah press Parish Express early and take control
scenarios.body: The two prominent runners with better recent form overhaul the front runner in the final furlong as their fitness edge tells. They avoid the traffic problems that will engulf the hold-up brigade behind them.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Finds Gap
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and one hold-up runner gets a clear run
scenarios.body: A horse like Quiz Test or Master Sydney with proven class finds the perfect passage through the field as others get hampered. The slow pace plays into their hands despite the tactical disadvantage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Duel Backfires
scenarios.trigger: If Whats New and Makaiah engage Parish Express in sustained early pressure
scenarios.body: The three prominent runners burn each other out in a pace battle, setting up the race for a closer with tactical speed. Medieval Night or Eternal Echo could benefit from the strong gallop.

watchPoints.text: Parish Express hanging left off the bend like at Roscommon could compromise her tactical advantage as the sole front runner
Traffic problems in the straight will be severe with 14+ hold-up horses converging - watch for interference
Makaiah's 9-day turnaround from Roscommon could catch up with her in the final furlong despite tactical edge
Celtic Druid's progressive Dundalk form may not translate to this softer turf surface at longer trip
Paradise Lost returning after 212 days with previous hurdles form could be much better than recent runs suggest

runners_data.spotlight: Dual hurdles winner is now 0-17 on the Flat and hard to see him breaking that sequence here.

races.paceDynamic: Velvet And Vine is the only confirmed front-runner in this 15-runner field, meaning she can dictate terms without early pressure over this extended 2m trip. With 14 hold-up horses behind her, the pace will be steady through the early stages before quickening from the home turn. The lack of pace pressure creates a tactical race where position and timing become crucial, with many runners needing luck in running from off the pace. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can track the leader and horses with proven tactical speed to pick up the pieces when the field bunches.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Velvet And Vine gets soft fractions and kicks clear turning in
scenarios.body: She can use her 491-day break as an excuse for fitness while getting first run of the race, holding off late challengers who get in each other's way. The abundance of hold-up horses creates traffic problems behind her.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly crawling and turns into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The tactical speed merchants can weave through and time their runs perfectly when 14 horses converge in the straight. Experienced campaigners with proven finishing kicks benefit most.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Velvet And Vine sets reasonable fractions but fades in the final furlong
scenarios.body: A horse sitting second or third can inherit the lead and prove hard to pass with so many others still struggling for racing room further back. The lack of early pace pressure helps stamina types.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Velvet And Vine goes too slow and multiple horses challenge simultaneously
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy cavalry charge where the best-handicapped horse can emerge from the pack. Fitness and current form become the deciding factors.

watchPoints.text: Velvet And Vine could steal this if she gets uncontested fractions and the field comes too late
Multiple reserves Bynx, Ethereal Star, and Sioux Grit may cause late declarations drama
Desert Friend's recent Sligo form makes him the most reliable each-way option in a wide-open heat
Traffic problems likely in straight with 14 hold-up horses needing racing room simultaneously
Going reports show consistent Good To Yielding across all distances, favoring those who handle cut
